name: Hermes AI Agent
description: Self-improving AI agent by Nous Research with skills, memory, and multi-platform support
longDescription:
# Hermes AI Agent

[Hermes](https://github.com/NousResearch/Hermes) is a self-improving AI agent by Nous Research that builds skills from experience and remembers how you work. It can be reached on WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, or Slack, supports MCP servers, and allows bringing your own LLM API key.

## Features
- **Self-Improving** - Builds skills from every interaction
- **Persistent Memory** - Remembers preferences, corrections, and workflows
- **Multi-Platform** - WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack
- **MCP Support** - Connect to Model Context Protocol servers
- **BYOK** - Bring Your Own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
- **Skill System** - Extensible capabilities via skills
- **Private Dashboard** - Web UI for management and monitoring

## Use Cases
- Personal AI assistant that learns your workflow
- Team productivity agent with shared memory
- Automated research and analysis
- Code review and development assistance
- Customer support automation

## Requirements
- Minimum 1GB RAM (2GB+ recommended)
- LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, or local via Ollama)
- Persistent storage for memory and skills
- Network access for MCP servers and platforms
